evidenceLines: The Master of Pre-Doctoral Business Studies is the first year of the Doctoral Program and constitutes one year of advanced coursework, including a research project. The degree has three core courses, providing a broadening of background in business research for all Doctoral students. Students also undertake a specialisation, ensuring they have completed appropriate field-specific preparatory advanced coursework for their chosen PhD degree. Entry into the PhD component of the Doctoral program requires a minimum overall average of 75 in the Master of Pre-Doctoral Business Studies and a minimum score of 85 in the Research Project Seminar.
